MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: S.Vantree, Proceedings reported by: Mitch Lyon , CSR#6840.

Larry Shockey Esq., appearing for Plaintiff, Michael Muhlenkamp and Angela Sun, Husband and Wife.

No appearance by defaulted defendant(s) Claudio Almeida Waqued dba Caffe d'Melanio.

After Evidence and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against Defaulted Defendant(s) as follows:

IT IS ORDERED, ADJUDGED AND DECREED that the plaintiffs shall recover damages from defendant Claudio Almeida Waqued dba Caffe d'Melanio, jointly and severally in the amount of $45,668.40.
The judgment shall take effect immediately.
The Clerk is ordered to enter the judgment.
Judgment signed in open court.
